We chose Freshservice over other IT service management tools primarily for its user-friendly interface, quick deployment, and strong automation capabilities. Compared to competitors, Freshservice stood out for being cloud-native, which aligned with our goal of modernizing our IT infrastructure without heavy overhead or complex configurations.

One of the biggest factors in our decision was Freshservice’s built-in AI and workflow automation tools, which helped us streamline repetitive tasks and reduce ticket resolution time significantly. We also appreciated its integration options with tools we already used, such as Microsoft 365, Slack, and Jira, which reduced friction in our day-to-day operations.

Since implementation, the impact has been clear:

Ticket resolution time decreased by 32% in the first six months.

Employee satisfaction scores (from internal IT support surveys) rose by 18%.

Our IT team is now able to handle about 25% more tickets per technician, thanks to the improved workflows and automation.

We also noticed a 20% reduction in escalated tickets, due to the improved self-service portal and knowledge base that Freshservice made easier to maintain.

Overall, Freshservice has allowed our IT team to move from reactive to proactive support, enhancing both team efficiency and employee experience.
